*   Update the `__main__` block in `tests/run_all_examples.py`:

## Changes made (source files only)

**`repo/Cargo.toml`** (serves as both the workspace root and the pixi binary package):
- `[workspace.dependencies]`: replaced `uv-toolchain` with `uv-python` at git tag `0.2.37`, and bumped every other astral-sh/uv crate (`uv-*`, plus the `distribution-*`, `install-wheel-rs`, `platform-tags`, `pypi-types`, `requirements-txt`, `pep440_rs`, `pep508_rs` entries) from tag `0.2.18` to `0.2.37`. - `tests/run_all_examples.py` (the `run_clean` flag / `--clean` argument work)
- `tests/install_tests.rs` (still references `uv_toolchain`)
